scope: Source-only C reads, pure synthetic1024B superblock and AST checks. No actual WSL/image/UNC/lock/process/ref mutation.

findings.problem: The clean-superblock predicates accept s_state=5 (clean bit plus orphan-recovery bit), while this phase claims a fully clean detached image.
findings.evidence: Pure1024B synthetic superblock with state5, no INCOMPAT_RECOVER, no RO_ORPHAN_PRESENT and last_orphan0 is accepted and returned as state5. Windows repeats the same partial bit predicate.
findings.source_detail: Kernel ext4 superblock state table defines0x0001 cleanly unmounted,0x0002 errors and0x0004 orphan recovery; checked live for this review.
findings.required_correction: Require exact integer state==1 in Linux parsing and Windows ledger join; add state5 and unknownstate-bit rejection cases before refreezing.

findings.problem: Windows admission books640MiB combined parent/worker allocation, but the parent is allowed512MiB RLIMIT_AS with no mechanical128MiB self boundary. The documented parent128+worker512 capacity partition is not enforced.
findings.evidence: Source sets bootstrap inherited RLIMIT_AS512MiB and requires2176MiB Windows reserve+allocation; check() validates lease/source/time but not parentRSS128. This review does not claim actual parent memory exceeded128.
findings.required_correction: Either book both512MiB allocations conservatively (1536+1024=2560MiB physical/commit) or explicitly enforce and document sampled parentRSS128 plus worker512 with per-process512AS; keep clear that sampling is not an aggregate kernel cap.

findings.problem: Terminal owned_command_count uses equality without exact integer type, so e.g8.0 can match total8 despite strict integer phase counts.
findings.evidence: The phase ledger already checks each command_count as int0/1; this is an additional terminal provenance hardening requirement, not evidence of unclosed native execution.
findings.required_correction: Require type(linux[owned_command_count]) is int before exact equality to the ledger sum.
